title: Join-rules router returns HTTP 500 join_rules_unavailable when the store reports `locked` (another writer holds the per-tenant lock, transient and retryable), identical to `lock-failed` / permission failures; a client cannot tell 'retry in a moment' from 'broken'. router.ts:14 comment also still says the store read-modify-write is unlocked.
evidence: Reproduction (on 1414d79): router with a store double whose recordOptOut/save/load throws JoinRulesStoreError code `locked`; POST /calendar/join-rules/opt-outs (and PUT, approvals) -> 500 {"error":"join_rules_unavailable"}, no Retry-After. Same body as code `lock-failed`.
fix_direction: Total code->status table; locked -> 503 join_rules_busy + Retry-After; lock-failed stays 500; no store message leaks.
reproductions: PUT with locked -> expect 503 join_rules_busy + Retry-After
lock-failed on all three -> still 500 join_rules_unavailable

title: The busy contract between api and web is not pinned: the 503 busy message string is duplicated and no test ties the two copies, the web 'busy' LOAD path (retry button + readText) is untested although the test title says 'on save and on load', and the Retry-After value is asserted only against the constant that defines it
area: apps/api/src/join-rules/router.ts BUSY; apps/web/src/pages/join-rules/joinRulesClient.ts BUSY_SERVER_MESSAGE, JoinRulesPage.tsx readText / load catch
evidence: Checker mutations on 5717bc0, each survived the full targeted suites: (a) api message 'join rules are busy; try again in a few seconds' -> 'join rules are busy, retry shortly': api 71/71 pass (no api test asserts the text), web 49/49 pass (web test uses its own literal); on drift the web shows 'Rule editing is not available on this server yet.' for a transient condition; (b) BUSY_RETRY_AFTER_SECONDS 5 -> 50 survives (busy-status.test.ts compares against the same constant); (c) JoinRulesPage load catch without `|| p.failure === "busy"` (no retry button) survives; (d) readText without the busy branch (load shows 'Unable to load join rules.') survives.
fix_direction: Add a test that reads the api message literal from the exported router constant and asserts the web BUSY_SERVER_MESSAGE equals it (or share via a contract fixture); assert Retry-After equals the literal "5"; add a web test for busy on initial load (message + retry button). Not security; no ceremony beyond the next unit touching these files.
reproduction: mutate per (a)-(d), run: cd apps/api; node --test --import tsx src/join-rules/router.test.ts src/join-rules/busy-status.test.ts; cd apps/web; node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run src/pages/join-rules
